proof.text: The sentry appears in `pieces` and nowhere else: no `setup.placements` entry places it, no `rules.promotion` target names it, and the game has no drops or other rule that could create a piece. So it is never on the board: it cannot move, take, be taken or hold a square, and every position, legal move and ending is the parent's. Mechanically: `same_moves` compares the two games' legal moves, spelled alike, in every position to two plies.
